title: Karaoke reception and booth details
caption: Open drink dispensers, cupboard joinery, a connected stair rail, separate cushions and AV fittings add detail to both public rooms. Every retained render attempt appears by round and capture time. Save and return checks pass; existing stage contact failures remain tracked in #349.

sections.title: Original rooms
sections.caption: Native door and stair interactions with scripted walking approaches. Original fixtures and recovered booth layout before the detail pass; some early side cameras faced outside the cutaway.

sections.title: First fixture pass
sections.caption: Open dispenser bays, counter joinery, supported stair rail, padded benches and AV detail. Review requested wall-panel contact and isolation of the new door frame from the interaction outline.

sections.title: Frame correction and first activity attempt
sections.caption: Door-frame highlight correction and wall-panel contact fixes. This shortened stage harness failed a microphone contact check; Continue was not reached. These are retained failed-attempt originals.

sections.title: Final room details and full stage attempt
sections.caption: Final fixture source: reception and booth reviewed at 8/10 at both sizes. Existing stage actions were invoked directly, not triggered through the story. Contact assertions failed before Continue; route and save proof follows below.

sections.title: Strict desktop and phone day tests
sections.caption: Both strict day-one fast runs passed. End-of-day frames supplement the focused room checks.

sections.title: Same-harness unchanged-room comparison
sections.caption: The identical full stage harness against unchanged main reproduces the receipt pickup failure. Original room source; no detail pass present.

sections.title: Existing canonical stage test on unchanged main
sections.caption: The existing canonical checker also records four failed pickup/handoff distances. It injects stage actions and sample dialogue, including English test text, rather than playing a story. First launch was GPU-deferred without images; these originals are from the retry.

sections.title: Continue and native return with contact failures retained
sections.caption: Final room source, existing stage invoked directly. Actual quicksave, title Continue, held-microphone/queue restoration and native exits to reception and street passed at both sizes. Scripted walking approaches lead to real pin/menu clicks. Overall checker remains failed because all four existing contact limits are exceeded; failure frames are taken after the successful return. Tracked in issue #349: https://github.com/fumbleforce/tower-of-words/issues/349.
